answer: Replica identities are cheap; unrepeatable work is not. Each applicant deposits a compact crystal of recent job transcripts at a public settlement wharf, together with a berth bond. The market then times a verification window to the week's nadir of live honest throughput, so a burst of sockpuppets cannot hide in congestion. Three incumbents with no shared funder independently re-execute sampled jobs. Only unanimous matches unseal standing; a duplicated transcript or a colluding pair burns half the bond and bars those keys for two epochs.
